descriptionChirho: All three clusters represent the single sense of praising God in worship. The multilingual glosses confirm complete semantic identity: Spanish 'alabando / alabad / a alabar' (praising / praise! / to praise), Arabic 'يسبّحون / سبّحوا / يسبّحون' (they praise / praise! / they praise), Korean '찬양하며 / 찬양하라 / 찬양하기를' (praising / praise! / to praise), Hindi 'स्तुति करते हुए / स्तुति करो / स्तुति करने' (praising / praise! / to praise), and Swahili 'wakimsifu / Msifuni / kumsifu' (praising him / praise him! / to praise him). The only differences are grammatical: participle, imperative, and infinitive forms of the same action.
